source: A solution-style {0} (one that only lists {1}) is type-checked in build mode automatically. {2} forces it, and {3} turns it off.
text: Un {0} de type solution (c'est-à-dire qui se contente de lister des {1}) est vérifié automatiquement en mode build. {2} force ce mode, et {3} le désactive.
